proyecto.descripcion: This project involves the development of an online store for pet products. I worked in collaboration with a team of 4 people, where we took on specific roles and divided tasks to maximize efficiency. My contribution included both backend and frontend work, ensuring an integrated workflow and an optimal user experience.

Project developed from scratch, where I implemented secure authentication with JWT and OAuth in a backend based on Node.js, Express, and Sequelize. I focused on backend architecture , ensuring a scalable and efficient design. Additionally, I collaborated with the team using GitHub Projects for task management and workflow organization.

A centralized platform that digitalizes and simplifies coexistence. It allows managing tasks, finances, communication, health, and security of a household from a single access point, offering adaptable interfaces based on the technical and cognitive profile of each user. Works 100% locally, without the need for internet or external access.

Independent collection of agent skills (SKILL.md format) and portable agents (markdown) organized by category. Self-contained project with canonical layout discovered by the npx skills ecosystem (Claude Code, Cursor, opencode, Qoder, Codex and 70+ more agents). Includes backend, frontend, QA/testing skills and portable agents.

A minimalist AI personal assistant that runs on your local machine and serves you from Telegram and a WebChat in the browser. 100% local or cloud, with dynamic tools, infinite memory, expanded expert system, triple RAG, intelligent terminal and CRON automation.
